method: Complete named explanatory fields from the exact subject/pointer. Original summaries, subjects and historical reviews unchanged. This is an excerpt, not a standalone replacement contract or review.

summary.answer: Takes menu f1_arg0, controller f1_arg1 and eight layout bounds f1_arg2..f1_arg9; calls LUI.UIElement.new and sets the literal class/id/sound. Creates four circle images with shader component 5, then six center-fractal images with alpha zero and shader component 1. Each image is added and published before the next is made. The exact asset hashes, dimensions and material parameters are preserved; no hacking progress or animation delivery is implemented in this selected body. Exact child order: DotCircle, BlurCircle, OuterCircle, InnerCircle, CenterFractal01, CenterFractal02, CenterFractal03, CenterFractal04, CenterFractal05, CenterFractal06. All layout/property/asset values and each callback body are retained in the ordered trace. Calls the optional same-file-or-unresolved PostLoadFunc at its exact source position, then returns self; a same name in another file supplies no binding. Base/child lifetime, model/event/animation delivery and native asset behavior remain external unless a reused exact provider contract explicitly supplies the bounded fact.
